item.description: The Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada jointly review and renew the Bank’s monetary policy framework every five years. The Bank then independently conducts monetary policy to achieve the framework’s goals. The Government and the Bank agree that monetary policy must work to promote the economic and financial well being of Canadians. We also agree that the best way monetary policy can do this is by keeping inflation low, stable, and predictable, thereby protecting Canadians from large…

item.title: Building a stronger Canada through a well-managed, predictable immigration system
item.description: An immigration system that is well-managed, efficient and focused on our economic needs is key to building Canada strong. Every year, Canada tables an immigration levels plan outlining the targets for temporary and permanent resident admissions for the next three years. Last year and through Budget 2025, we committed to taking back control over the immigration system and putting Canada on a trajectory to bring immigration back to sustainable levels.

item.title: Budget 2026: Key Measures
item.description: It accelerates investment and, builds on Canada's energy and natural resource advantage, and helps Canadians get ahead. And it does so with the fiscal discipline needed to build a stronger Canada for the future.
